injuries.name: Jan Jenik
injuries.note: Jenik had nine goals, 17 points and 29 PIM in 43 AHL regular-season outings between Belleville and Ontario in 2025-26. He will probably be sent to the minors once he's recovered from his injury.

injuries.name: Kevin Fiala
injuries.note: Fiala is slated to begin skating on his own next week, so he is making progress. He hasn't played since suffering the injury during the 2026 Winter Olympics. Fiala is expected to serve in a top-six capacity and will likely also be part of the first power-play unit once he's healthy.

injuries.name: Calum Ritchie
injuries.note: Ritchie is currently mired in a five-game pointless streak during which he has generated four blocks, two shots and two PIM while averaging 10:38 of ice time. With the 21-year-old forward sidelined long-term, he likely will be placed on injured reserve in the coming days to free up a roster spot. For now, Mitchell Chaffee could get an extended run at the NHL level with both Ritchie and Matias Maccelli (lower body) dealing with injuries.

injuries.name: Matias Maccelli
injuries.note: Maccelli suffered a lower-body injury in Saturday's 4-1 win over Toronto. He has contributed two goals, six points and 13 shots on net in eight appearances with the Islanders this season.

injuries.name: Mathew Barzal
injuries.note: Barzal racked up 72 points in 81 regular-season games last year, including 20 power-play points and four game-winning goals. At this point, the team hasn't offered any specific recovery timeline for the 29-year-old center. Whenever Barzal returns, it should be in a top-six role that includes time with the man advantage.

injuries.name: Quinton Byfield
injuries.note: Upper Body: The Kings said that Byfield is a Out for Thursday's (Oct. 22) game versus the Islanders.

injuries.name: Jakub Dvorak
injuries.note: Upper-body: The Los Angeles Kings placed D Jakub Dvorak on injured reserve non-roster list.

injuries.name: Kevin Fiala
injuries.note: Leg: The Los Angeles Kings said on Thursday (Sept. 17) that Fiala s at least three weeks away from being ready to play, per Zach Dooley of the Kings' official site.

injuries.name: Jan Jenik
injuries.note: Undisclosed: The Los Angeles Kings placed F Jan Jenik on injured reserve non-roster list.

injuries.name: Alex Turcotte
injuries.note: Undisclosed: The Los Angeles Kings placed F Alex Turcotte on injured reserve on Saturday (Oct. 10).

injuries.name: Mathew Barzal
injuries.note: Knee: The New York Islanders said on Thursday (Oct. 15) that Barzal has been skating on his own, but there is no timeline for his return, according to Andrew Gross of Newsday.

injuries.name: Matias Maccelli
injuries.note: Lower Body: The Islanders said on Monday (Oct. 19) that Maccelli will miss the next 2-4 weeks.

injuries.name: Calum Ritchie
injuries.note: Lower Body: HC DeBoer said on Monday (Oct. 19) that Ritchie will be out of action for 4-6 weeks.

injuries.name: Alexander Romanov
injuries.note: ACL: The New York Islanders placed D Alexander Romanov on injured reserve on Monday (Oct. 19).
